title: Leaving school when her mother died; her father's railroad shop work
summary: She left school when her mother died, recalls a brother's marriage and money, and says her father died first and worked in the shops.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth
